<awtsmoosMeluketTranslation heichel="ikar" alias="meluket_translation_en" seriesId="שבט_meluket" postId="BH_POST_1766518916815_theRebbe_81" batchId="meluket-_D7_A9_D7_91_D7_98_meluket__BH_POST_1766518916815_theRebbe_81__p007">
  <section v="18">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>The soul's power to overcome all obstacles below comes from its root in the Essence of Ein Sof, which is above any will for worlds and thus above any alien will.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">And based on this, it can be said,</t>
    <t s="1">that this [the fact] that he [the Rebbe] elaborates in the maamar about the greatness of the elevation of the soul when it is above, up to the elevation of "there is no stranger with Him"</t>
    <t s="2">[even though the content of this chapter is that the main service of the soul is specifically below],</t>
    <t s="3">is</t>
    <t s="4">(also)</t>
    <t s="5">in order to hint at the power that the soul has in its descent below to overcome all hindrances and obstacles.</t>
    <t s="6">And the explanation is,</t>
    <t s="7">that this [fact] that the soul was in a single will with Havayah alone and there is no stranger with Him,</t>
    <t s="8">is</t>
    <t s="9">(primarily)</t>
    <t s="10">from the aspect of its root in the Essence of Ein Sof, which is above the will to emanate and create.</t>
    <t s="11">[For in the will to emanate and create,</t>
    <t s="12">since the will is that there should be worlds,</t>
    <t s="13">there is there a root and a place of allowance for an alien will</t>
    <t s="14">(and not only for the level of the aforementioned alien will,</t>
    <t s="15">an existence of utter nullification,</t>
    <t s="16">but also for an alien will in its simple sense,</t>
    <t s="17">for the will that there should be worlds is that there should also be the worlds of Beriah, Yetzirah, and Asiyah, down to this physical world).</t>
    <t s="18">And this [fact] that the soul was in a single will with Havayah alone and there is no stranger with Him,</t>
    <t s="19">it can be said that the intention in this is,</t>
    <t s="20">that there is also no place of allowance for an alien will</t>
    <t s="21">(even not for an existence of utter nullification),</t>
    <t s="22">for this matter in the soul is from the aspect that it is rooted in the Essence of Ein Sof, which is above the will for worlds,</t>
    <t s="23">where there is no place of allowance whatsoever for any existence outside of Him].</t>
    <t s="24">And since from the aspect of its root in the Essence of Ein Sof,</t>
    <t s="25">the matter of "there is no one but One in Yaakov"</t>
    <t s="26">(the soul above)</t>
    <t s="27">is drawn in revelation also in the tribes</t>
    <t s="28">(the soul below),</t>
    <t s="29">therefore,</t>
    <t s="30">even when it is in a body full of alien wills</t>
    <t s="31">(alien in their simple sense)</t>
    <t s="32">and physical and material desires that prevent the soul from divine service,</t>
    <t s="33">it has the power to overcome them.</t>
  </section>
  <section v="19">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>After explaining that the soul's descent is to refine the body, the maamar adds that the main service is specifically below, leading to the advantage of *itkafya* (subjugation).</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">10)</t>
    <t s="1">And 4)</t>
    <t s="2">And behold, after the maamar explains that the descent of the soul below is in order to refine and purify the body and the animal soul and to illuminate its portion in the world,</t>
    <t s="3">it adds,</t>
    <t s="4">that the main service</t>
    <t s="5">(of the soul)</t>
    <t s="6">is specifically below.</t>
    <t s="7">For since the body is full of alien wills and physical and material desires that prevent the soul from divine service,</t>
    <t s="8">therefore it requires service and immense toil in a most difficult war.</t>
    <t s="9">And it can be said,</t>
    <t s="10">that this addition that the main service is specifically below is to explain another matter that is accomplished in the soul through its descent below – the advantage of *itkafya*.</t>
    <t s="11">For this that it said earlier that the descent of the soul below is in order to refine and purify the body and the animal soul etc. is that through its descent below it comes to the elevation of *it'hapcha* (transformation),</t>
    <t s="12">and this that below is the main service</t>
    <t s="13">(service and immense toil in a most difficult war)</t>
    <t s="14">is that through its descent below it comes to the elevation of *itkafya*.</t>
    <t s="15">And based on what was explained above</t>
    <t s="16">(section 7),</t>
    <t s="17">that in chapter twenty he explains the inner point of all the matters in the *Hemshech* (series),</t>
    <t s="18">that the inner point of all matters in the world is these matters as they are in man,</t>
    <t s="19">it can be added,</t>
    <t s="20">that in the preceding chapters he explains</t>
    <t s="21">(primarily)</t>
    <t s="22">the matter of *itkafya* and *it'hapcha* in the world that is accomplished through man's service,</t>
    <t s="23">and in chapter twenty he explains the matter of *itkafya* and *it'hapcha* in man's own service.</t>
  </section>
  <section v="20">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>Prayer, the service of the heart, unites the immanent and transcendent aspects of G-d, drawing down the infinite light above the chain of descent to effect change in the world.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">10)</t>
    <t s="1">A)</t>
    <t s="2">And behold, in the service of man there are three lines,</t>
    <t s="3">Torah, service, and acts of kindness.</t>
    <t s="4">And it can be said,</t>
    <t s="5">that the reason why the line of service specifically is called by the name "service"</t>
    <t s="6">is,</t>
    <t s="7">because the empowerment for the matter of service that is in all three lines</t>
    <t s="8">(service and immense toil in a most difficult war),</t>
    <t s="9">is through the line of service,</t>
    <t s="10">the service of the offerings,</t>
    <t s="11">and in the time of exile – the service of prayer.</t>
    <t s="12">And this will be understood based on what the Tzemach Tzedek explains in the maamar beginning "And you shall serve Havayah your G-d"</t>
    <t s="13">that this refers to the service of prayer,</t>
    <t s="14">for the matter of prayer</t>
    <t s="15">(prayer from the term "connection")</t>
    <t s="16">is to connect *Malchus*,</t>
    <t s="17">the aspect of *Memaleh Kol Almin* (the immanent light that fills all worlds),</t>
    <t s="18">with the aspect of *HaSovev* (the transcendent light that surrounds all worlds).</t>
    <t s="19">And there are two matters in this.</t>
    <t s="20">For prayer itself</t>
    <t s="21">(the service of prayer of man)</t>
    <t s="22">is to elevate *Malchus* to the transcendent light,</t>
    <t s="23">"I will exalt You, my G-d the King",</t>
    <t s="24">a connection of *Memaleh* and *Sovev* in a manner from below to above,</t>
    <t s="25">and the drawing down from above that comes through prayer is the connection of *Sovev* and *Memaleh* in a manner from above to below,</t>
    <t s="26">that the transcendent light which is above the chain of descent is drawn in revelation into *Malchus*.</t>
    <t s="27">And it can be said,</t>
    <t s="28">that this is "And you shall serve Havayah your G-d",</t>
    <t s="29">for Havayah is *Sovev* and Elokim is *Memaleh*,</t>
    <t s="30">and the explanation of "And you shall serve Havayah your G-d" is,</t>
    <t s="31">that the matter of "and you shall serve"</t>
    <t s="32">(the service of prayer)</t>
    <t s="33">is that Havayah</t>
    <t s="34">(*Sovev*)</t>
    <t s="35">shall be "your G-d",</t>
    <t s="36">your power and your vitality.</t>
    <t s="37">And this that through prayer there is a unification of *Sovev* and *Memaleh*,</t>
    <t s="38">the Tzemach Tzedek explains there,</t>
    <t s="39">that prayer is a ladder planted in the earth whose head reaches the heavens,</t>
    <t s="40">the connection of the soul in the body</t>
    <t s="41">(earth)</t>
    <t s="42">with the soul above</t>
    <t s="43">(heavens),</t>
    <t s="44">for the soul in the body is analogous to *Memaleh* and the soul above</t>
    <t s="45">[which is an aspect of *Makif* (encompassing light) for the soul in the body]</t>
    <t s="46">is analogous to *Sovev*,</t>
    <t s="47">and through the unification of *Memaleh* and *Sovev* in man, the unification of *Memaleh* and *Sovev* above is accomplished.</t>
    <t s="48">And this can be connected with the matter of prayer in its simple sense,</t>
    <t s="49">that a person asks for his needs,</t>
    <t s="50">for the fulfillment of the requests in prayer is through the unification of *Sovev* and *Memaleh*.</t>
    <t s="51">For this that a change occurs in the creations below</t>
    <t s="52">(that the sick person is healed etc.)</t>
    <t s="53">is through the drawing down of the Ein Sof light that is above the chain of descent</t>
    <t s="54">(for from the perspective of the chain of descent, it was decreed upon him that he should be sick),</t>
    <t s="55">and this that through the drawing down of the light that is above the chain of descent, particular influences are bestowed</t>
    <t s="56">(healing of the sick,</t>
    <t s="57">blessing of the years, and the like)</t>
    <t s="58">is through the light that is above the chain of descent being drawn into the chain of descent.</t>
  </section>
</awtsmoosMeluketTranslation>
